target.title: docs(durable): propose durable core runtime boundary and validation plan
target.body:
## Context capsule

This is PR 1/5 for a sequential durable-core stack. It is intentionally docs-only: RFC, root-cause summary, and validation plan before any runtime implementation is submitted.

The proposed boundary keeps the durable core generic and reusable: runtime run identity, lifecycle/event recording, checkpoints, recovery semantics, cancellation/terminal states, and read-only operator inspection. Product-specific surfaces are explicitly non-goals.

## Scope

- Adds `docs/specs/durable-runtime-rfc.md`.
- Adds `docs/specs/durable-runtime-root-cause-and-test-plan.md`.
- No implementation code, migrations, CLI, gateway methods, or tests are included in this PR.
- Workboard and TaskFlow are explicitly out of scope except as possible future consumers that must not define the core boundary.

## Validation

- `git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD` shows docs-only files.
- Searched for private branch/worktree/proof references in the new docs.
- Verified Workboard/TaskFlow references are confined to non-goals/out-of-scope statements.
- Searched for `test.only`/`test.skip` style markers in the new docs.
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` passed.

## Not tested / deferred

No live runtime proof, restart smoke, database migration, CLI command, gateway method, or agent integration was run for this PR because it is docs-only. Those checks are deferred to the implementation PRs that introduce code.


## What Problem This Solves

OpenClaw durable-runtime recovery work needs an agreed core boundary before implementation PRs land. Prior recovery/runtime discussions mixed generic durability concerns with product-specific Workboard/TaskFlow surfaces, which made it harder to review the planned stack safely and sequentially. This docs-only PR establishes the RFC, root-cause summary, and validation plan for the generic durable core while explicitly deferring runtime code and product-specific consumers to later PRs.

## Evidence

- Docs-only scope verified with `git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD`: only `docs/specs/durable-runtime-rfc.md` and `docs/specs/durable-runtime-root-cause-and-test-plan.md` are added.
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` passed locally.
- Searched the new docs for private branch/worktree/proof references; none were present.
- Verified Workboard/TaskFlow references are limited to non-goals/out-of-scope/future-consumer framing.
- Searched the new docs for `test.only` / `test.skip` style markers; none were present.
- Live runtime proof, migrations, CLI/gateway behavior, and integration checks are intentionally deferred because this PR contains no implementation code.
